observations: Each single-state mechanism is 40/40 without reset and 0/40 when its own backing state is reset.
Resetting all non-spike state eliminates decoder/filter/algorithmic delayed recall but leaves spike-latch recall intact.
A spike+decoder hybrid remains 40/40 after either single-channel reset and fails only after all state is reset, demonstrating masking by redundant hidden state.
